title: Andes Horror: The Unthinkable Survival Choice
script:
They ate their friends to live.
This was no horror movie.
It was the Andes Mountains, October 1972.
Uruguayan Air Force Flight 571 crashed.
Carrying a rugby team and their companions.
Stranded at 12,000 feet.
Temperatures plunged to minus 30 Celsius.
No food. No rescue for weeks.
After two weeks, they faced an impossible decision.
To survive, the living consumed the dead.
16 people endured 72 horrific days.
Could you make that unthinkable choice to see another sunrise?
comment: What's the most extreme survival story you know?
